decisions.reason: The charting bundle has an active release cadence and its own page, and as a plugin on the established map.apps platform it costs little to keep while its demand is still uncertain.
The hierarchical search bundle has only a brief mention, so evidence about its value is thin, but it is a cheap add-on to the core platform and worth keeping open.
VueTOC was featured on the home page with a claimed usability gain, but it is a small component whose value is still unresolved, and keeping it costs little.
The software platform is the firm's flagship and strategic direction, a core commitment rather than a marginal option, so dropping it is very unlikely.
Mobile field data capture has its own page and fits the firm's established enterprise GIS offer, and its prospects are still developing, so the option should stay open.
The search extension is presented on a page of its own and sits close to the core offer, with low maintenance cost and no evidence yet of poor value.
